description: This is an HTML file for a web-based database viewer interface. It includes structure, styles, and client-side JavaScript code for fetching and displaying database, table, and data information.

methods.name: loadDatabases
methods.description: Fetches list of databases from server and populates sidebar

methods.name: refreshDatabases
methods.description: Refreshes the list of databases, resets current selections

methods.name: toggleDatabase
methods.description: Toggles display of tables for a selected database

methods.name: loadTables
methods.description: Fetches list of tables for selected database and displays them

methods.name: loadTableData
methods.description: Fetches and displays data for a selected table

methods.name: renderTable
methods.description: Creates an HTML table from data array for display

methods.name: renderCell
methods.description: Generates HTML for a table cell based on value type

methods.name: expandCell
methods.description: Expands or collapses cell content for better visibility
